To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
sarcopenia is defined by low muscle quantity, low muscle quality and low muscle strength.
sarcopenia is defined as a medical syndrome with three key characteristics: low muscle strength, low muscle quantity and low physical performance.
sarcopenia is low muscle mass and/or low muscle strength, with low muscle quality and poor physical performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the health and well-being of older adults by promoting healthy muscle ageing.
the identification of the most appropriate diagnostic criteria for sarcopenia, and the development of clinical tools that will help to improve the care of people with sarcopenic muscle loss.
identifying and caring for those with sarcopenia and preventing its development in the first place.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sarcopenia is an age-related disease that can occur earlier in life; it is rooted in muscle failure that results from adverse muscle changes that occur across a lifetime.

sarcopenia is an age-related muscle disease that is characterised by low muscle strength and mass and poor physical performance, and which is associated with adverse health outcomes and increased risk of disability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sarcopenia is not just an age-related condition.

EWGSOP2 has updated and refined our 2010 recommendations for sarcopenia diagnosis in order to improve consistency in research design and clinical diagnosis, with the ultimate goal of increasing care for people with muscle disease.

EWGSOP2 recommends that the diagnosis of sarcopenia be made when low muscle quantity and/or quality is present and is accompanied by low muscle strength, or when low muscle strength is present and is associated with low muscle quantity and low physical performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sarcopenia is preventable.
sarcopenia is an important and treatable health condition.
sarcopenia is an important condition that can be diagnosed, and that its diagnosis is important for the health of older people.
